programme.title: VIVEMENT DIMANCHE
programme.desc: On his iconic red sofa, Michel Drucker welcomes and shines the spotlight on the talent of yesterday, today and tomorrow. A main guest talks about their career, their projects and their origins...

programme.title: DESTINATION FRANCOPHONIE
programme.desc: A journey throughout the French-speaking world to explore every corner of the globe! In each country we meet francophones who present, in French, their culture, way of life and commitments. The programme also shines a spotlight on local projects that keep the French language alive, dynamic and constantly evolving.

programme.title: PEUPLES DES SOMMETS
programme.desc: Peuples des Sommets explores cultures, traditions, and survival strategies of people living in high-altitude regions.

programme.title: PEUPLES DES SOMMETS
programme.desc: Peuples des Sommets menyoroti budaya, tradisi, dan cara bertahan hidup komunitas pegunungan.

programme.title: HEÏDI'S ICE
programme.desc: Glaciologist Heïdi Sevestre travels across the Svalbard archipelago to observe its changing glaciers. Through fieldwork and scientific explanations, she highlights their beauty, fragile condition and the consequences of melting ice for the planet.

programme.title: HEÏDI'S ICE
programme.desc: Ahli glasiologi Heïdi Sevestre menjelajahi kepulauan Svalbard untuk mengamati perubahan gletser. Melalui penelitian lapangan dan penjelasan ilmiah, ia menunjukkan keindahan, kondisi rapuh, serta dampak pencairan es bagi bumi.

programme.title: QUESTIONS POUR UN CHAMPION
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: COUSU
programme.desc: Actress and presenter Karine Vanasse explores how fashion reflects culture and personal identity, travelling from Argentina to Belgium and Morocco to discover the stories behind clothing and style.

programme.title: COUSU
programme.desc: Aktris dan presenter Karine Vanasse menjelajahi bagaimana mode mencerminkan budaya dan identitas pribadi, dari Argentina hingga Belgia dan Maroko, untuk menemukan kisah di balik pakaian dan gaya.

programme.title: LE JOURNAL DE FRANCE 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (8 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: BOUQUINISTES, LE CHARME DE PARIS
programme.desc: Along the banks of the Seine, this documentary meets the bouquinistes, iconic booksellers who have shaped the cultural identity of Paris for centuries. Their passion for literature and rare books offers a glimpse into the city's living literary heritage.

programme.title: BOUQUINISTES, LE CHARME DE PARIS
programme.desc: Di sepanjang Sungai Seine, dokumenter ini mengenal para bouquinistes, penjual buku ikonik yang telah menjadi bagian dari identitas budaya Paris selama berabad-abad. Kecintaan mereka pada sastra dan buku langka memperlihatkan warisan literasi kota yang terus hidup.

programme.title: LA VÉNUS DE BOTTICELLI, NAISSANCE D'UNE ICÔNE
programme.desc: This documentary examines Sandro Botticelli's The Birth of Venus, exploring its Renaissance origins, rediscovery and lasting influence. From cinema and fashion to contemporary art and popular culture, the famous painting continues to inspire new interpretations.

programme.title: LA VÉNUS DE BOTTICELLI, NAISSANCE D'UNE ICÔNE
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini mengulas The Birth of Venus karya Sandro Botticelli, mulai dari asal-usulnya pada era Renaisans hingga kembali populernya karya tersebut. Dari film dan mode hingga seni kontemporer, lukisan ini terus menginspirasi berbagai interpretasi baru.

programme.title: TOP 14 RUGBY LE MAG
programme.desc: Presenting the day's action in the Top 14, the French rugby championship, with summaries and highlights from the matches, players interviews and comments.

programme.title: MELODY
programme.desc: Melody, a determined young hairdresser, accepts a surrogacy agreement with Emily, a successful businesswoman longing for a child. As their relationship deepens beyond the original arrangement, both women confront loneliness, trust, and the meaning of family while transforming each other's lives.

programme.title: MELODY
programme.desc: Melody, seorang penata rambut muda, menerima tawaran menjadi ibu pengganti bagi Emily, perempuan sukses yang mendambakan seorang anak. Seiring waktu, hubungan mereka berkembang melampaui kesepakatan awal dan membawa keduanya menghadapi kesepian, kepercayaan, serta makna keluarga yang sesungguhnya.

programme.title: ENFANTS D'HIER
programme.desc: Noah, 21, returns to the foster home of his adolescence to collect his belongings. Meeting Thaïs, a teenager now living in his former room, forces him to confront memories of his past and the words he has long kept unspoken.

programme.title: ENFANTS D'HIER
programme.desc: Noah, 21 tahun, kembali ke panti tempat ia tinggal saat remaja untuk mengambil barang-barangnya. Pertemuannya dengan Thaïs, remaja yang kini menempati kamar lamanya, membuat Noah menghadapi kembali masa lalu dan hal-hal yang selama ini sulit ia ungkapkan.

programme.title: LAISSEZ-VOUS GUIDER
programme.desc: LAISSEZ-VOUS GUIDER invites viewers to rediscover France’s historical landmarks, traditions, and untold stories. Guided by passionate hosts and experts, each episode blends history, architecture, and anecdotes to bring iconic places and forgotten treasures back to life.

programme.title: LAISSEZ-VOUS GUIDER

Dipandu oleh pembawa acara dan pakar yang penuh semangat, setiap episode memadukan sejarah, arsitektur, dan anekdot untuk menghidupkan kembali tempat-tempat ikonik maupun harta karun yang terlupakan.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda and Indy are sisters who love each other dearly. Their mother, Rianty, died while giving birth to Indy. Since then, Manda and Indy have lived as a family of three with their father, Indra. Manda has taken on the role of a mother to Indy. One day, their father began to fall ill and was admitted to the hospital. It turned out that Indra had leukemia.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. Sejak saat itu, Manda dan Indy hanya hidup bertiga bersama ayahnya, Indra. Manda berperan sebagai ibu bagi Indy. Suatu ketika ayah mereka mulai sakit sakitan dan masuk rumah sakit. Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.
